title: Boundary wall maximum length, R20-R25 (greater of 9 m or 35% of the boundary)
text: C3.4.4 Boundary walls may be built in accordance with Table 3.4c provided: i. boundary walls are located behind the street setback; ii. overshadowing does not exceed the limits of C3.9.1; and iii. they are finished to an equivalent standard to the rest of the development, to the satisfaction of the decision-maker. Table 3.4c Lot boundary setbacks, maximum boundary wall length: R20 - R25 The greater of 9m or 35% of the lot boundary the wall abuts.

parts.label: not more than 35% of the boundary it abuts

exceptions.label: abuts an existing or simultaneously constructed wall of similar or greater dimension (C3.4.5)

replaces.note: one-third of the balance behind the setback -> 35% of the whole boundary

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Either limb satisfies the test (the greater of). Percentage is of the whole lot boundary, not the balance behind the street setback.

verified.note: Table value is clear. Figure 3.4h (p36), cited for R10-R25, labels its walls 'does not exceed 65% of lot boundary', which does not match the 35% in Table 3.4c; the table governs.
